scene: You roll off the sky gondola onto the breezy turbine racetrack deck.
picture: Flat side view along a high metal platform. On the far left sits the open sky gondola. To its right is a yellow robotic pitkart. The player in her purple wheelchair rests left of centre. In the centre rises a massive white wind turbine tower. On the far right is a glowing race ramp.
shown: a yellow robotic pitkart parked on the deck on the left
a giant white turbine tower base with an access valve in the centre
a glowing chequered race ramp starting line on the far right

variants.scene: The sky gondola delivers you to this buzzing, windy rooftop race track.
Cool evening air greets you as you roll onto the high metal platform.
You arrive at the turbine deck, still humming {tune} in the breeze.
